name: env-cap-example-team-service
description: Multiple capability-owned env.schema.ts files (postgres, mongodb, prisma, auth), spanning two real teams, with a --check CI gate -- no central schema to edit when a capability is added, removed, or swapped.

scripts.docs: env-cap --location src/generated/env.manifest.ts --docs docs/ENVIRONMENT.md --env-example .env.example --env-example-on-existing overwrite --ownership docs/OWNERSHIP.md --evidence docs/env.evidence.json
